content.en: Shuffle the eight star-marked expansion cards into the Sea Salt & Paper base-game deck. All base-game turn and end-round rules remain unchanged.
content.zh: 将八张带星标的扩展卡洗入《海盐折纸》本体牌堆；回合和结束规则保持不变。

content.en: Jellyfish plus Swimmer locks opponents to a top-deck draw next turn. Lobster plus Crab reveals five cards, lets you keep one, then returns and shuffles the other four.
content.zh: 水母加泳客让对手下回合只能从牌堆顶抽牌；龙虾加螃蟹翻开五张，留一张，其余四张洗回。

alt.en: Jellyfish+Swimmer locks opponents; Lobster looks at 5
alt.zh: 水母+泳客锁对手；龙虾看顶 5 留 1

content.en: Starfish turns a duo into a three-card, three-point set but cancels that duo's effect. Seahorse fills a missing collector card, while Crab Multiplier scores one point per other Crab.
content.zh: 海星把组合对变为三张三分，但取消组合效果；海马补一张收集牌；螃蟹大军按其他螃蟹数量得分。

alt.en: Starfish trio, Seahorse collector, Crab multiplier
alt.zh: 海星三人组、海马补收集、螃蟹大军

content.en: The expansion adds two Jellyfish, one Lobster, three Starfish, one Seahorse, and one Crab Multiplier. The normal duo and STOP rules still apply.
content.zh: 扩展新增两张水母、一张龙虾、三张海星、一张海马和一张螃蟹大军；组合与喊停规则仍照本体执行。

alt.en: Use the count table; duos still 2; STOP still works
alt.zh: 看张数表，组合仍是 2，喊停仍可用
